scope.metric: Established-connection whole-operation latency; setup/handshake excluded, validation and cleanup included.
scope.order: Rotate variants then reverse every complete cycle; five repetitions do not exactly balance positions.

trace_scope: Entire peer lifecycle, including handshake, ciphertext, shutdown, QUIC ACK/retry/control packets. Attempts include errors, would-block and unreturned calls at termination; unreturned calls are counted separately. Batched UDP returns datagrams, not bytes. No Capn Proto message count inference.
cpp_quic: unsupported by pinned KJ; no substitute or proxy
limitations: Single-host loopback and available CPU affinity; no WAN, loss or handshake latency conclusions.
OpenSSL versus rustls/ring versus quiche/BoringSSL are different crypto stacks. Server authentication only.
Historical plaintext results are separate. No performance gate closed by this encryption rollout.
